Pattern

Tap a square to add a hit, again for a soft (ghost) hit, again to remove. On a phone, swipe the pattern sideways to see every beat. Click a drum name to hear it. Keys: Space play/stop · / ±1 BPM · / ±5 BPM · F fill · T tap.
